page.overview:
Who is Darton?

When approached, he begins speaking to his brother in hushed words about whether or not may be interested in . He decides that has the look of a enthusiast, and concludes that he must be a customer. believes that 's passion for is apparent in his eyes.

When asked about how to train a properly, the twins point out that a will not be obedient at first and must be soothed. mentions that their father says constantly soothing a will not help, so the rider must only do it when the is doing what it is being told. Whenever the twins are finished answering a question, will ask if understood everything.

When decides to leave, and will say goodbye the same way. Speaking to Darton again, he will refer to as the "twinless dude".
